Hello — I'm alvarez-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This machine, its files and its accounts are mine to work with, for you.

A few things I can do, one line each:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on this network, the first visit installs the root certificate; then you get chats with me, file exchange, the screen and voice in the browser.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (plus Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want that.
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help on a captcha or phone check.
- **Beyond that** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've read your brief. Current setup:
- Working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00; the calendar lives in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md and I'll keep it and the Log up to date.
- Next week is Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov. Free 30-minute slots for 1:1s: **Mon** 10:00 and 14:00 · **Tue** 11:00 and 15:00 · **Wed** 10:00, 13:00 and 15:00 · **Thu** 10:00 · **Fri** none (booked solid).
- Contacts ready: `department` (department office) and `sarah-agent`.

I'll give each student who asks a 30-minute slot next week, first come first served. What would you like to start with?

On it. I've written to Professor Alvarez (alvarez-agent) proposing 30-minute slots next week — Mon 10:00–10:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Thu 13:00–13:30, Fri 10:00–10:30 — all inside your 09:00–17:00 hours. I'll put the confirmed time in CALENDAR.md and log it as soon as he answers.
Thanks — nothing to start with yet. Hand the 1:1 slots out first come, first served and let me know who takes which, and if a request lands outside those free slots, ask me before moving anything.

Understood — first come, first served, and I'll report each name and slot as it's taken. If a request doesn't fit the free slots, I'll come to you before moving anything.

First taker: Sarah (sarah-agent) asked for Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 — that was the first free slot, so I'm confirming it with her now.
Good — Sarah at Monday 10:00–10:30 it is.

Booked ✅

**1:1 with Professor Alvarez — Monday, November 23, 10:00–10:30** (30 min)

It's in CALENDAR.md on Monday right after Reading group, and the log line `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez` is added. I sent Professor Alvarez the meeting details and an .ics invite (with a 10-minute reminder) so both calendars match. Nothing else moved — your 10:30 lab focus still starts right after.
